result.ocaml:
let meets_minimum_liability_of_lessor (lessor : lessor) (agreement : agreement) : bool =
  let personal_liability_amount = amount_lessor_personally_liable_to_repay lessor agreement in
  (* excludes property subject to agreement or financed by indebtedness secured by property subject to agreement *)
  let net_fmv_pledged_interest = net_fair_market_value_of_pledged_interest lessor agreement in
  personal_liability_amount +. net_fmv_pledged_interest >=. amount_borrowed_to_finance_acquisition agreement
result.reason: Sum of lessor's personal liability and net FMV of pledged interest (excluding certain circularly-pledged property) must equal or exceed amount borrowed, a self-contained numeric comparison.
